## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Aṅguttaranikāye Ekakanipāta-ṭīkā* is a Pali subcommentary (ṭīkā) belonging to the Tīkā Aṅguttaranikāya section, providing exegetical glosses on the *Ekakanipāta-aṭṭhakathā* (the commentary to the "Book of the Ones" of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya*). In secondary scholarship, the work is consulted for its doctrinal and terminological explanations; for instance, Andrea Schlosser cites its gloss on the "three attainments" (*tissannaṃ sampattīnaṃ*), which it identifies through oral tradition (*anussavavasena*) either as human, divine, and liberation attainments (*manussadevamokkhasampattiyo*) or human, divine, and Brahma attainments (*manussadevabrahmasampattiyo*) [Schlosser 2016].

No cross-language matches with Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora are identified [DharmaNexus]. Within the Pali canon and its exegetical literature, however, DharmaNexus records extensive text reuse, registering 40,904 matching passages across 411 Pali works [DharmaNexus]. Its largest textual overlaps are found with other canonical subcommentaries and commentaries, foremost among them the *Majjhimanikāye Mūlapaṇṇāsa-ṭīkā* (1,472 matches, including segment range §74_1–117_1 aligning with §17_2–61_1), the *Dīghanikāye Sīlakkhandhavaggaṭīkā* (777 matches), the *Dīghanikāye Sīlakkhandhavaggaabhinavaṭīkā* (1,074 matches), the *Saṃyuttanikāye Sagāthāvaggaṭīkā* (677 matches), and its primary root commentary, the *Aṅguttaranikāye Ekakanipāta-aṭṭhakathā* (1,110 matches) [DharmaNexus].
